decisions.reason: An evening psychiatric day-patient program builds directly on the firm's existing psychiatric care knowledge, so it can interpret early results and refine the program, and its own page signals commitment.
The carpentry workshop extends the sheltered-workshop and occupational-therapy activities common to such providers, giving it moderate related knowledge despite its craft and commercial character.

Outpatient sociotherapy is closely related to the firm's psychiatric and social care expertise and fits statutory reimbursement structures, though its mere mention suggests it is still being assimilated.
Senior living counseling draws directly on core residential care knowledge, and its home page placement shows strategic priority.

A retail shop requires commercial knowledge further from the firm's care competence, and its low website visibility raises some risk, but it supports the sheltered workshop's mission and is cheap to maintain.
